requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-849-2033-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-849-2033-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Anax triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-5662-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Reyhan.
When Reyhan dies, its persist ability and innate ability trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reyhan from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the innate trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on a creature.
Repeat.

3532-3536-5078-7736.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat from step 2

3490-5231-6822-7256.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
3490-5231-6822-7256.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
When the Servo dies, Warhost's Frenzy triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

1399-1606-1671-7176.description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Ley Weaver to gain all creature types.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2

1144-2645-3688-6871.description:
Activate Staff of Domination by tapping it, adding {G} as it's a Forest land due to Toph and Yavimaya.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1384-4636-6320.notablePrerequisites: You are able to generate an additional {E}{E}{E}{E} each turn.
1384-4636-6320.description:
During your upkeep, if Gonti's Aether Heart is in your graveyard, activate Academy Ruins by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, putting Gonti's Aether Heart from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your draw step, drawing Gonti's Aether Heart.
Cast Gonti's Aether Heart by paying {6}.
Saheeli triggers, causing you to get {E}.
When Gonti's Aether Heart enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart that is a 5/5 artifact creature with haste.
Put the nontoken Gonti's Aether Heart into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Gonti's Aether Hearts trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
If needed, generate up to an additional {E}{E}{E}{E} until you have eight {E} available.
Activate the Gonti's Aether Heart by paying eight {E} and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2866-2981-3200-4986.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

3234-3293-4050-5414.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-4050-5414.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Repeat
3234-3293-4050-5414.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2173-2448-3025-5220.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2173-2448-3025-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: has been foretold on a previous turn

1000-2067-6753.manaNeeded: {8}{W}{W}{U} plus an additional {1} if Mystic Reflection is in your hand
1000-2067-6753.description:
Cast Mystic Reflection either from your hand by paying {1}{U} or from exile for its foretell cost by paying {U}, choosing Exalted Sunborn.
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to twice your life total that enter as copies of Exalted Sunborn due to Mystic Reflection.
Whenever you create one or more tokens, you will instead create 2^X times that many tokens, where X is the number of Exalted Sunborns you control.
1000-2067-6753.notes: This combo can be done at any life total, but the higher the better. If you have 20 life, this combo makes 40 tokens in step 1, and then applies a multiplier of 2^41 for each token created afterwards, accounting for the 40 tokens and the nontoken Exalted Sunborn.

1268-3918-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Clues.
1268-3918-5527.description:
Activate Trazyn using Five Hundred Year Diary's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.

1323-1902-4687.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
1323-1902-4687.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Wirewood Channeler's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

3372-5231-5295-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-5231-5295-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {R}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

856-4779-5632-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

457-1115-5159-5491.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-1115-5159-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

4499-4685-4893.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Prosperous Pirates.
When Prosperous Pirates enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact with MV<=2 that has a generic mana cost

1393-2364-3967-4986--31.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Aether Channeler, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Cast the other artifact with MV<=2 by paying at most {2}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Aether Channeler, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.
Cast Mana Vault by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the other artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-3558-3856-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, adding {C}{C}.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, choose not to pay for the trigger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ruxa, adding {C}{C}.
When Ruxa dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Ruxa from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ruxa enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.

643-1636-2366-3346-4147.notablePrerequisites:
Bog Glider and Hua Tuo do not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
643-1636-2366-3346-4147.description:
Activate Bog Glider by tapping it and sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Dryad Arbor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bog Glider ability, searching your library for Dryad Arbor and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1349-2034-2793-4742-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Athreos' second ability and Nahiri's Resolve trigger.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, putting a coin counter on Ugin's Nexus.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, adding {C}{C}.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Athreos' third ability triggers, causing you to return Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Nahiri's Resolve trigger from step 2, exiling Ugin's Nexus until your next upkeep.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Nahiri's Resolve triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

914-2438-3719.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2438-3719.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a Treasure token, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

719-2102-3690.description:
Cast Sylvan Awakening by paying {2}{G}, causing all lands you control to become 2/2 Elemntal creatures with haste until end of turn.
Activate Griffin Canyon's second ability by tapping it, untapping itself and giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 2.

413-643-4242-4640.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping and sacrificing Su-Chi.
Su-Chi and Oathkeeper triggers.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Oathkeeper trigger, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Equip Oathkeeper to Su-Chi by paying {2}.
Repeat.
